properties.name: i2f.springboot.ai.enable
properties.description: enable ai common auto configuration.

properties.name: i2f.springboot.ai.json-serializer.enable
properties.description: create the IJsonSerializer bean (JacksonJsonSerializer) when missing.

properties.name: i2f.springboot.ai.json-schema-annotation-resolver.enable
properties.description: create the JsonSchemaAnnotationResolver bean when missing.

properties.name: i2f.springboot.ai.agent.enable
properties.description: enable ai agent auto configuration and create the AiAgent bean when missing.

properties.name: i2f.springboot.ai.model.enable
properties.description: enable ai model auto configuration.

properties.name: i2f.springboot.ai.model.rest-openai.enable
properties.description: create the AiModel bean by HttpOpenAiAiModel (rest template based), takes effect when no other AiModel bean exists.

properties.name: i2f.springboot.ai.model.rest-openai.base-url
properties.description: openai compatible api base url.

properties.name: i2f.springboot.ai.model.rest-openai.api-key
properties.description: openai compatible api key.

properties.name: i2f.springboot.ai.model.rest-openai.model
properties.description: model name, e.g. qwen-plus.

properties.name: i2f.springboot.ai.model.dashscope.enable
properties.description: create the AiModel bean by DashScopeModel, requires dashscope sdk on classpath.

properties.name: i2f.springboot.ai.model.dashscope.api-key
properties.description: dashscope (aliyun bailian) api key.

properties.name: i2f.springboot.ai.model.dashscope.model
properties.description: dashscope model name, e.g. qwen-plus.

properties.name: i2f.springboot.ai.model.openai.enable
properties.description: create the AiModel bean by OpenAiModel (official openai sdk), requires openai sdk on classpath.

properties.name: i2f.springboot.ai.model.openai.base-url
properties.description: openai api base url.

properties.name: i2f.springboot.ai.model.openai.api-key
properties.description: openai api key.

properties.name: i2f.springboot.ai.model.openai.model
properties.description: openai model name.

properties.name: i2f.springboot.ai.rags.enable
properties.description: enable ai rags (retrieval augmented generation) auto configuration.

properties.name: i2f.springboot.ai.rags.embedding.enable
properties.description: create the RagEmbeddingModel bean by HttpOpenAiRagEmbeddingModel when missing.

properties.name: i2f.springboot.ai.rags.embedding.base-url
properties.description: embedding api base url (openai compatible).

properties.name: i2f.springboot.ai.rags.embedding.api-key
properties.description: embedding api key.

properties.name: i2f.springboot.ai.rags.embedding.model
properties.description: embedding model name, e.g. text-embedding-v3.

properties.name: i2f.springboot.ai.rags.embedding.dimension
properties.description: vector dimension of the embedding model, used by the sqlite embedding store.

properties.name: i2f.springboot.ai.rags.embedding.enable-load-docs
properties.description: whether to load documents from docs-path on startup.

properties.name: i2f.springboot.ai.rags.embedding.docs-path
properties.description: document directory to load, documents are moved into a sibling rags_history directory after loading.

properties.name: i2f.springboot.ai.rags.embedding.max-segment-size-in-chars
properties.description: max segment size in chars of the recursive text splitter.

properties.name: i2f.springboot.ai.rags.embedding.docs-embed-batch-size
properties.description: store batch size when embedding loaded documents, -1 means no limit.

properties.name: i2f.springboot.ai.rags.embedding.max-overlap-rate
properties.description: max overlap rate between adjacent text segments.

properties.name: i2f.springboot.ai.rags.store.enable
properties.description: create the RagEmbeddingStore bean (SqliteRagEmbeddingStore) when missing.

properties.name: i2f.springboot.ai.rags.docs-store.enable
properties.description: create the RagDocumentsStore bean (SqliteRagDocumentsStore) when missing.

properties.name: i2f.springboot.ai.rags.worker.enable
properties.description: create the RagWorker bean when missing, loads docs asynchronously 3 seconds after creation.

properties.name: i2f.springboot.ai.rags.tool.enable
properties.description: create the RagTools bean when missing.

properties.name: i2f.springboot.ai.rags.reader.markitdown.enable
properties.description: create the markitdown command rag file reader bean.

properties.name: i2f.springboot.ai.rags.reader.easycor.enable
properties.description: create the easyocr command rag file reader bean.

properties.name: i2f.springboot.ai.rags.reader.pdf-easycor.enable
properties.description: create the pdf (convert to images) + easyocr rag file reader bean, requires pdfbox on classpath.

properties.name: i2f.springboot.ai.rags.reader.pandoc.enable
properties.description: create the pandoc command rag file reader bean.

properties.name: i2f.springboot.ai.rags.memory.bucket.enable
properties.description: create the BucketRagEmbeddingStore bean (SqliteBucketRagMemoryStore) when missing.

properties.name: i2f.springboot.ai.rags.memory.enable
properties.description: create the MemoryTools bean when missing.

properties.name: i2f.springboot.ai.skills.enable
properties.description: enable ai skills auto configuration, scans file system skills every 30 seconds.

properties.name: i2f.springboot.ai.skills.tool.enable
properties.description: create the SkillsTools bean.

properties.name: i2f.springboot.ai.skills.runner.groovy.enable
properties.description: enable the groovy skill script runner.

properties.name: i2f.springboot.ai.tools.enable
properties.description: enable ai tools auto configuration.

properties.name: i2f.springboot.ai.tools.mcp.app.enable
properties.description: create the ContextAppMcpToolProvider bean when missing.

properties.name: i2f.springboot.ai.tools.mcp.manager.enable
properties.description: create the ToolManager bean (ContextMcpToolGatewayManager) when missing.

properties.name: i2f.springboot.ai.tools.app.manager.enable
properties.description: create the ToolManager bean (ContextAppToolManager) when missing.

properties.name: i2f.springboot.ai.tools.mcp-gateway.enable
properties.description: create the McpProviderTools bean bridging the AbstractMcpToolGatewayManager.

properties.name: i2f.springboot.ai.tools.groovy-dynamic-tools.enable
properties.description: enable the groovy dynamic tool provider component.

properties.name: i2f.springboot.ai.proxy.enable
properties.description: enable ai service (@AiService) dynamic proxy auto configuration.

properties.name: i2f.springboot.ai.proxy.handler.enable
properties.description: create the AiServiceDynamicProxyHandler bean when missing.

properties.name: i2f.springboot.ai.proxy.service-packages
properties.description: packages scanned for @AiService interfaces, defaults to **.ai.** and **.service.** when empty.
